neighbours.label: ' a' in 'N and a (half)' after a number or unit ('two and a half', 'year-and-a-half')
fire: We waited for two and a half hours before the doctor arrived.
The baby is now a year and a half old and already walking.
The house sits on about three and a half acres of farmland.
He signed a contract for another season and a half with the club.
The renovation took nearly four and a half months to finish.
She has run the shop for six and a half years without a break.
The recipe needs one and a half cups of flour.
The hike was roughly five and a half miles long.
quiet: We waited for two or three hours before the doctor arrived.
The baby is now eighteen months old and already walking.
The house sits on about four acres of good farmland.
He signed a contract for another full season with the club.
The renovation took nearly four long months to finish.
She has run the shop for six years without a single break.
The recipe needs one full cup of flour and some salt.
The hike was roughly five miles long and quite steep.

notes: 32/32 top examples are ' a' or '-a' in '<number/unit> and a half'. The model is causal, so the pole must fire on ' a' before seeing 'half'; the context is the number/unit + 'and'.
